name: 95642 · Jackson, CA
findings: ZIP 95642 (Jackson) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 13 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95642 (Jackson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95642 (Jackson) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
